name.zh: 珠雫冻结五十人与雷切对战预告
name.en: Shizuku Freezes Fifty and Draws Toka Todo

periods.summary: Shizuku challenges the whole free-training arena, freezes roughly fifty students, and receives notice that her next opponent is Toka Todo.
periods.cause: Shizuku wants a serious fight and is tired of carefully accumulating selection wins against weak opponents.
periods.process: She invites all present knights to attack her at once. Without leaving the center of the ring or allowing her skirt to be touched, she turns the arena into a frozen field and immobilizes everyone.
periods.outcome: The spectators call her a monster; Shizuku remains unsatisfied but smiles when her handbook names Toka as her next opponent.
periods.aftermath: The next volume's high-ranked selection battles are foreshadowed, beginning with Shizuku versus Hagun's strongest student.
periods.significance: Shows Shizuku's destructive capacity and introduces the Raikiri matchup cliffhanger.
